sql: WITH t AS (SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, market_ticker AS mkt, split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) AS seg2, split_part(market_ticker,'-',3) AS seg3 FROM paper_trades WHERE status = ANY(ARRAY['settled','closed_sl']) AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND strategy LIKE '%%mmsell%%' AND split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) = ANY(ARRAY['KXTRUMPSAY','KXNFLSPREAD','KXRAIN','KXWTI','KXBTCD','KXALBUMEQUIV','KXMLBHR','KXNFLTOTAL'])) SELECT series, count(DISTINCT mkt) AS mkts, count(DISTINCT seg2) AS distinct_seg2, count(DISTINCT seg3) AS distinct_seg3, min(mkt) AS example_a, max(mkt) AS example_b FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
